Players Committee card image of [[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed, you may ▼ an alien leader aboard for free. Immune to attrition < 5.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/jabbasspacecruiser.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/jabbasspacecruiser.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
